reason: The second end of a double weapon. Its m_DisplayNameText points at a shared string that holds an item description, not a name, so writing it would put game text other than a display name into data/ (ADR 0006). Clearing the shared key leaves it nameless, like the other 728 nameless sourced items; it is a part, worn only with its parent weapon (BlueprintItemWeapon.m_SecondWeapon).
